name: io.github.LuxorLabs/tenki-mcp
title: Tenki Sandbox MCP
description: Disposable microVM sandboxes for AI agents: run code, read/write files, git, preview URLs.

environmentVariables.name: TENKI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Tenki API key (starts with tk_). Alternatively set TENKI_AUTH_TOKEN (an ory_st_ session token or session cookie); the header is chosen by token prefix.

environmentVariables.name: TENKI_API_ENDPOINT
environmentVariables.description: Override the control-plane endpoint. Defaults to https://api.tenki.cloud.
